title: New Breakthrough in Multimodal Video Models: MiniMax Officially Releases H3 and Promises Open-Source Weights

content_html:
After continuously investing in large language model technology, the AI company MiniMax has recently officially launched its new multimodal generation model MiniMax H3 and pledged to fully open-source the model weights within a few days.

As a generation model that supports multimodal context input, MiniMax H3 can receive any combination of text, images, videos, and audio as input, and finally output high-definition videos with native stereo audio. In practical applications, users only need to provide reference videos, images, or audio materials to the model, combined with natural language instructions, to seamlessly complete complex audio-visual content creation.

On the technical architecture side, MiniMax H3 has completely broken away from the traditional approach of splitting expert models by task in multimodal models. The development team integrated various tasks such as text-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, and audio processing into a single pre-training framework, introducing a more concise H3-Omni Transformer architecture, which increased end-to-end training throughput by nearly 30%. At the same time, through the H3-VAE architecture brought about by rewriting the Tokenizer, it achieved extremely high compression rates, effectively reducing inference costs at high resolutions.

Regarding pricing and ecosystem, MiniMax H3 costs less than one-third of mainstream similar models per second at 2K resolution, and during the design phase, full consideration was given to compatibility with domestic chips. Currently, the model shows broad application potential in scenarios such as movie openers, game UI animations, dynamic posters, and e-commerce ads. Its accuracy in text rendering and brand information presentation has also been significantly improved.

content_html_zh:
在不断投入大语言模型技术后，AI公司MiniMax于近日正式推出了全新的多模态生成模型MiniMax H3，并承诺在几天内将模型权重完全开源。

作为支持多模态上下文输入的生成模型，MiniMax H3 可以接收文本、图像、视频和音频的任意组合作为输入，最终输出带有原生立体声音频的高清视频。 在实际应用中，用户只需向模型提供参考视频、图像或音频素材，结合自然语言指令，即可无缝完成复杂的视听内容创作。

在技​​术架构方面，MiniMax H3完全脱离了多模态模型中按任务拆分专家模型的传统做法。 开发团队将文本转图像、文本转视频、图像转视频、音频处理等各种任务集成到一个预训练框架中，引入了更简洁的H3-Omni Transformer架构，使端到端训练吞吐量提高了近30%。 同时，通过重写Tokenizer带来的H3-VAE架构，实现了极高的压缩率，有效降低了高分辨率下的推理成本。

在定价和生态方面，MiniMax H3在2K分辨率下每秒的成本不到主流同类机型的三分之一，并且在设计阶段就充分考虑了与国产芯片的兼容性。 目前，该模型在电影开场、游戏UI动画、动态海报、电商广告等场景中展现出广泛的应用潜力。 其在文字渲染和品牌信息呈现的准确性上也得到了显着提升。
